title: The salt wells: Pa Kluea's story
kaylee: The salt hut gets a story like Lung's rice farm: a way-in film, the story coming back between rounds, and a payoff she does herself. Choose one of three.
questions: Which story: Bracelet, Sea or Soup?
Is Pa Kluea (Auntie Salt, the pony) a good name, or do you want another?

links.label: The salt hut as it is now

pitches.title: Grandma's Lost Bracelet
pitches.finger: Dip the bucket and see what comes up; scrape the salt to find what the well kept.
pitches.learns: Boil the water away and what was in it stays: the salt, and the bracelet.
pitches.silly: The bucket brings up Daddy's sunglasses, a sandal, a grumpy frog.
pitches.why: A mystery she solves herself, and a sparkly treasure at the end.
also: Memory film: little Pa Kluea drops Grandma's bracelet down the well. Plop!
"The well keeps what it loves. One day it gives it back."
Pa Kluea wears it in the trip photo

pitches.title: The Sea Under the Mountain
pitches.finger: Every bucket brings up a bit of the old sea; the steam draws sea friends she pops.
pitches.learns: The real fact: long, long ago a sea was here, and it left its salt in the mountain.
pitches.silly: Blow on the fire too hard and the steam makes a giant octopus that sneezes.
pitches.why: She loves Little Lost Dolphin: a gentle sea friend, and a wonder moment.
also: Memory film: the valley under a blue sea, the big old turtle swimming over the hills
Her payoff: a jar of salt for Grandma Turtle. For a moment the hut fills with sea

pitches.title: No Salt for the Soup!
pitches.finger: Make the salt in a hurry, then carry it down the street and sprinkle it into every pot.
pitches.learns: Salt makes food yummy, and keeps eggs and fish good for a long time.
pitches.silly: Sprinkle too much and the buffalo uncle's face puckers up tight.
pitches.why: A comedy mix-up like Peck's Trail Mix, and she gets to save the party.
also: Opening film: the village dinner tonight, and every cook's salt jar is empty
New street scene: buffalo noodle uncle, hen egg auntie, goose fish grandma
Lanterns light up stall by stall; the party starts
